story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: From an idea to a leading AI solutions provider
story.p1: Primitive AI was founded in 2020 by Doan Nguyen, an AI expert with extensive experience in artificial intelligence and robotics. What began as a vision has quickly grown into a comprehensive AI solutions provider serving clients worldwide.
story.p2: Our journey began with a simple belief: that advanced AI technology should be accessible to businesses of all sizes. We've expanded our offerings to include solutions for workplace safety, customer support, legal operations, and document processing — all powered by cutting-edge large language models.
story.p3: Today, Primitive AI is self-funded and employs AI specialists, engineers, and industry experts dedicated to developing innovative solutions that drive real business value.

milestones.title: Our Journey
milestones.subtitle: Key milestones in our company's growth

items.title: Company Founded
items.description: Primitive AI was established with a mission to make AI bring good for mankind — building products that help businesses and communities thrive.

items.title: VisionHub — First Product Launch
items.description: Released our flagship Camera AI platform for real-time workplace safety monitoring, PPE compliance, and human-robot interaction detection across manufacturing and construction sites.

items.title: SupportHub Launch
items.description: Launched our LLM-powered chatbot and voice bot platform, enabling businesses to automate customer support and sales conversations with high accuracy and natural language understanding.

items.title: KnowledgeHub & AI Services
items.description: Released KnowledgeHub — our enterprise knowledge management and intelligent document processing platform. Simultaneously launched our professional AI development services including AI Agent Development, Workflow Automation, and Model Fine-Tuning.

items.title: LegalHub — Beta
items.description: Launched LegalHub in beta — an AI-powered platform for legal document generation, review, and e-signature management. Early adopters are already cutting document turnaround from days to hours. Full release coming soon.

items.title: FamilyHub & Global Expansion
items.description: Launched FamilyHub to bring AI-powered knowledge preservation to individuals and families. Expanded our enterprise client base across Asia-Pacific and North America, serving 10+ industries with our full AI product and services portfolio.
